messages:
aline: Repro: duplicate POSTs from SDK after quick network toggle on Pixel 7A with Retrofit+OkHttp. Sample app in the repro folder.
drew: Can you paste short logs? wondering if it's adapter retry + okhttp follow-up double-play.
aline: snippet: I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/session (id=0x7f3)
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/session (id=0x7f3-clone)
I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/session (id=0x7f3-clone-2)
nina: Yep. Our suspend CallAdapter does a clone-based retry on IOException and OkHttp's RetryAndFollowUpInterceptor can also issue follow-ups when TLS handshake/new connection occurs (pinning active).
drew: So two problems: adapter-level retry plus OkHttp-level follow-ups. Also cloned streaming bodies are risky for non-idempotent endpoints.
aline: Proposal: 1) Remove retry-from-adapter and rely on OkHttp config. 2) Add generated X-Idempotency-Key header for session/create when caller omits one. 3) Defensive check in adapter: if call.isExecuted then avoid clone().
nina: Add emulator matrix tests for Android 12/13 toggling network, assert server sees <=1 create. I'll add Pixel-7a images to CI.
drew: Patch will: drop adapter retry code, add idempotency header generation, and add adapter guard. Mark WIP and include unit+instrumentation tests.
build-bot: Job queued: android-network-flaky-smoke #9002 (matrix: pixel-7a:12,pixel-7a:13).
aline: Filed GH issue linking sample app & test plan, will update CHANGELOG under java/kotlin sdk parity notes.
drew: If CI green we'll cut 0.14.2 patch and backport to 0.13.x for affected customers.
aline: thanks — adding a small docs note in devex/samples about "avoid adapter-level retries for non-idempotent calls".
